Auto-discovery idea: Aldoc expression tracks lamina-associated chromatin signal¶

Rationale¶

Aldoc is available in the linked RNA matrix and may mark cell-state differences that are reflected in nuclear peripheral organization.

Data used¶

Use linked Aldoc expression, cell type labels, spot-to-cell assignments, and the LaminB1 IF track measured on chromatin spots.

Analysis sketch¶

For each cell, compute the mean LaminB1 signal over all chromatin spots assigned to that cell. Correlate this per-cell LaminB1 chromatin-associated signal with Aldoc expression.

Expected result¶

If Aldoc-high cells have more lamina-proximal or lamina-associated chromatin, Aldoc expression should increase with mean LaminB1 signal.

Validation checks¶

Check all required fields, verify sufficient cells and spots per cell, require finite means, report a Spearman p-value, rerun deterministically, and use shuffled Aldoc labels as a negative control.

Critique and compact analysis plan¶

The idea is directly computable with the available linked RNA matrix and per-spot IF tracks, but the sample size is only 9 cells (3 per listed cell type). I will therefore treat this as an exploratory across-cell association rather than a definitive cell-type-adjusted model. The primary test will be a Spearman rank correlation between per-cell Aldoc expression and the per-cell mean LaminB1 spot signal, with a fixed-seed permutation/randomization null generated by shuffling Aldoc labels across cells. The plot will show the observed cell-level relationship and the observed Spearman rho against its permutation null distribution.

# Main compact exploration: Aldoc expression vs per-cell mean LaminB1 spot signal.
import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLBACKEND', 'Agg')
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg', force=True)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from IPython.display import Image, display

PROJECT_ROOT = Path('/Users/weizexu/Projects/U-Chrom')
REL_FIG_PATH = Path('tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/run_pantheon_20_ideas_verified_agg/aldoc-expression-tracks-lamina-associated-chroma-4c06d0d43e_statistical_summary.png')
REL_RESULT_PATH = Path('tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/run_pantheon_20_ideas_verified_agg/aldoc-expression-tracks-lamina-associated-chroma-4c06d0d43e_result.csv')
FIG_PATH = PROJECT_ROOT / REL_FIG_PATH
RESULT_PATH = PROJECT_ROOT / REL_RESULT_PATH
FIG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RESULT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Align cell metadata and linked Aldoc expression by cell id.
cell_ids = pd.Index(map(str, cdata.cells.index), name='cell_id')
adata_obs = pd.Index(map(str, adata.obs_names), name='cell_id')
if not cell_ids.equals(adata_obs):
    raise ValueError('cdata.cells.index and linked_adata.obs_names are not aligned; refusing implicit merge')
if 'Aldoc' not in adata.var_names:
    raise ValueError('Aldoc not found in linked_adata.var_names')

aldoc_idx = list(adata.var_names).index('Aldoc')
aldoc_expr = np.asarray(adata.X[:, aldoc_idx].toarray()).ravel() if hasattr(adata.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(adata.X[:, aldoc_idx]).ravel()

# Per-cell LaminB1 summary over all assigned spots.
spot_cell = cdata.spots['cell_id'].astype(str)
lamin = pd.to_numeric(cdata.tracks['LaminB1'], errors='coerce')
per_cell_lamin = lamin.groupby(spot_cell, observed=True).agg(['mean', 'count']).rename(columns={'mean': 'mean_LaminB1', 'count': 'n_finite_LaminB1_spots'})
spot_counts = cdata.spots.groupby(spot_cell, observed=True).size().rename('n_spots')

cell_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'cell_id': cell_ids.astype(str),
    'cell_type': cdata.cells['cell_type'].astype(str).to_numpy(),
    'Aldoc_expression': pd.to_numeric(aldoc_expr, errors='coerce'),
}).set_index('cell_id')
cell_df = cell_df.join(per_cell_lamin, how='left').join(spot_counts, how='left')
cell_df['n_spots'] = cell_df['n_spots'].fillna(0).astype(int)
cell_df['n_finite_LaminB1_spots'] = cell_df['n_finite_LaminB1_spots'].fillna(0).astype(int)
cell_df['finite_for_test'] = np.isfinite(cell_df['Aldoc_expression']) & np.isfinite(cell_df['mean_LaminB1'])

valid = cell_df.loc[cell_df['finite_for_test']].copy()
n = len(valid)
min_spots_per_cell = int(valid['n_finite_LaminB1_spots'].min()) if n else 0

null_hypothesis = 'Across cells, Aldoc expression is not positively associated with per-cell mean LaminB1 chromatin spot signal; Spearman rho is <= 0 or no greater than label-shuffle expectation.'
alternative_hypothesis = 'Across cells, higher Aldoc expression is associated with higher per-cell mean LaminB1 chromatin spot signal; Spearman rho is > 0.'
test_method = 'Spearman correlation with fixed-seed one-sided permutation test (1000 Aldoc-label shuffles)'

rng = np.random.default_rng(4060)
n_perm = 1000
if n >= 3 and valid['Aldoc_expression'].nunique() >= 2 and valid['mean_LaminB1'].nunique() >= 2:
    observed_rho = float(spearmanr(valid['Aldoc_expression'], valid['mean_LaminB1']).statistic)
    perm_rhos = np.empty(n_perm, dtype=float)
    y = valid['mean_LaminB1'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    x = valid['Aldoc_expression'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    for i in range(n_perm):
        perm_rhos[i] = float(spearmanr(rng.permutation(x), y).statistic)
    # One-sided positive association p-value; add-one smoothing for bounded randomization inference.
    p_value = float((np.sum(perm_rhos >= observed_rho) + 1) / (n_perm + 1))
    effect_size = observed_rho
    hypothesis_test_status = 'pass'
    test_note = 'Permutation p-value tests positive Spearman association by shuffling Aldoc labels across cells.'
else:
    observed_rho = float('nan')
    perm_rhos = np.array([], dtype=float)
    p_value = float('nan')
    effect_size = float('nan')
    hypothesis_test_status = 'insufficient_data'
    test_note = 'Insufficient finite cells or variability for Spearman/permutation test.'

# Include the test result columns on every cell-level row so the CSV is self-contained.
result_table = valid.reset_index().copy()
result_table['observed_statistic'] = observed_rho
result_table['effect_size'] = effect_size
result_table['p_value'] = p_value
result_table['test_method'] = test_method
result_table['hypothesis_test_status'] = hypothesis_test_status
result_table['expected_direction'] = 'positive'
result_table.to_csv(RESULT_PATH, index=False)

# Stratified descriptive reporting, not used as the primary hypothesis test.
stratified = valid.groupby('cell_type', observed=True).agg(
    n_cells=('Aldoc_expression', 'size'),
    mean_Aldoc=('Aldoc_expression', 'mean'),
    mean_LaminB1=('mean_LaminB1', 'mean'),
    min_spots=('n_finite_LaminB1_spots', 'min'),
).reset_index()

analysis_summary = {
    'idea_id': IDEA.idea_id,
    'parameter_name': 'Spearman rho between per-cell Aldoc expression and mean tracks.LaminB1',
    'parameter_value': observed_rho,
    'observed_statistic': observed_rho,
    'effect_size': effect_size,
    'p_value': p_value,
    'test_method': test_method,
    'null_hypothesis': null_hypothesis,
    'alternative_hypothesis': alternative_hypothesis,
    'hypothesis_test_status': hypothesis_test_status,
    'n_selected_cells': int(n),
    'n_rows': int(len(result_table)),
    'n_permutations': int(n_perm if hypothesis_test_status == 'pass' else 0),
    'min_finite_LaminB1_spots_per_cell': min_spots_per_cell,
    'cell_type_counts': valid['cell_type'].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict(),
    'result_path': str(REL_RESULT_PATH),
    'figure_path': str(REL_FIG_PATH),
    'notes': [test_note, 'Primary association pools all 9 cells; cell type is reported descriptively only because n=3 per type.'],
}

# Statistical figure: data relationship and observed statistic vs permutation null.
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.6), facecolor='white')
colors = {'Granule': '#1f77b4', 'Bergmann': '#ff7f0e', 'Purkinje': '#2ca02c'}
for cell_type, sub in valid.groupby('cell_type', observed=True):
    axes[0].scatter(
        sub['Aldoc_expression'], sub['mean_LaminB1'],
        s=70, alpha=0.9, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.6,
        label=f'{cell_type} (n={len(sub)})', color=colors.get(cell_type, 'gray')
    )
# Simple least-squares guide line in data coordinates, not used for inference.
if n >= 2:
    coeff = np.polyfit(valid['Aldoc_expression'].to_numpy(float), valid['mean_LaminB1'].to_numpy(float), deg=1)
    xs = np.linspace(valid['Aldoc_expression'].min(), valid['Aldoc_expression'].max(), 100)
    axes[0].plot(xs, coeff[0] * xs + coeff[1], color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, label='linear guide')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Aldoc expression (linked RNA counts)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Mean LaminB1 signal per chromatin spot (a.u.)')
axes[0].set_title('Cell-level Aldoc vs LaminB1')
axes[0].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.25)

if len(perm_rhos):
    axes[1].hist(perm_rhos, bins=25, color='#c7c7c7', edgecolor='white', label='Aldoc-label shuffle null')
    axes[1].axvline(observed_rho, color='#d62728', linewidth=2.2, label=f'observed rho={observed_rho:.3f}')
    axes[1].axvline(np.nanmean(perm_rhos), color='black', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.2, label=f'null mean={np.nanmean(perm_rhos):.3f}')
else:
    axes[1].text(0.5, 0.5, 'Insufficient data for permutation null', ha='center', va='center')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Spearman rho under shuffled Aldoc labels')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Permutation count')
axes[1].set_title('Hypothesis-test evidence')
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.25)

fig.suptitle('Aldoc expression and lamina-associated chromatin signal', fontsize=13)
fig.text(0.5, 0.01, f'{test_method}; one-sided p={p_value:.4f}; effect size=rho={effect_size:.3f}; n={n} cells', ha='center', fontsize=9)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 0.94))
fig.savefig(FIG_PATH, dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
display(Image(filename=str(FIG_PATH)))

display(result_table)
print(json.dumps(analysis_summary, indent=2))

checks = {check: 'not_run' for check in IDEA.validation_checks}
notes = []
checks.setdefault('statistical_hypothesis_test', 'not_run')

def _check_keys(prefix):
    return [key for key in checks if key == prefix or key.startswith(prefix + ':')]

def _set_check(prefix, value):
    keys = _check_keys(prefix)
    if not keys:
        checks[prefix] = value
        return
    for key in keys:
        checks[key] = value

def _check_status(prefix):
    values = [checks[key] for key in _check_keys(prefix)]
    if not values:
        return None
    if 'fail' in values:
        return 'fail'
    if all(value == 'pass' for value in values):
        return 'pass'
    return values[0]

_set_check('required_fields_exist', 'pass' if review is not None and review.accepted else 'fail')
if _check_keys('cell_id_alignment'):
    aligned = True
    if cdata is not None and adata is not None and len(cdata.cells) == len(adata.obs_names):
        aligned = list(map(str, cdata.cells.index)) == list(map(str, adata.obs_names))
    _set_check('cell_id_alignment', 'pass' if aligned else 'fail')
if _check_keys('minimum_cell_count'):
    n_cells = analysis_summary.get('n_selected_cells')
    if n_cells is None and 'cell_type' in getattr(result_table, 'columns', []):
        n_cells = len(result_table)
    if n_cells is None:
        n_cells = len(cdata.cells) if cdata is not None and getattr(cdata, 'n_cells', 0) else 0
    _set_check('minimum_cell_count', 'pass' if n_cells >= 1 else 'fail')
if _check_keys('minimum_spot_or_trace_count'):
    n_rows = analysis_summary.get('n_rows')
    if n_rows is None:
        n_rows = len(result_table) if result_table is not None else 0
    _set_check('minimum_spot_or_trace_count', 'pass' if n_rows >= 1 else 'fail')
if _check_keys('finite_numeric_output'):
    value = analysis_summary.get('parameter_value')
    _set_check('finite_numeric_output', 'pass' if value is not None and np.isfinite(value) else 'fail')
if _check_keys('statistical_hypothesis_test'):
    p_value = analysis_summary.get('p_value')
    test_method = analysis_summary.get('test_method')
    null_hypothesis = analysis_summary.get('null_hypothesis')
    alternative_hypothesis = analysis_summary.get('alternative_hypothesis')
    observed_statistic = analysis_summary.get('observed_statistic')
    effect_size = analysis_summary.get('effect_size')
    hypothesis_test_status = analysis_summary.get('hypothesis_test_status', 'pass')
    try:
        p_float = float(p_value)
    except Exception:
        p_float = np.nan
    try:
        stat_float = float(observed_statistic)
    except Exception:
        stat_float = np.nan
    try:
        effect_float = float(effect_size)
    except Exception:
        effect_float = np.nan
    has_required_test = (
        test_method is not None
        and str(test_method).strip() != ''
        and null_hypothesis is not None
        and str(null_hypothesis).strip() != ''
        and alternative_hypothesis is not None
        and str(alternative_hypothesis).strip() != ''
        and np.isfinite(p_float)
        and 0.0 <= p_float <= 1.0
        and np.isfinite(stat_float)
        and np.isfinite(effect_float)
        and hypothesis_test_status != 'insufficient_data'
    )
    if result_table is not None and hasattr(result_table, 'columns'):
        has_required_test = has_required_test and 'p_value' in result_table.columns and 'test_method' in result_table.columns
    else:
        has_required_test = False
    _set_check('statistical_hypothesis_test', 'pass' if has_required_test else 'fail')
    if not has_required_test:
        notes.append('statistical_hypothesis_test failed: analysis_summary must include null_hypothesis, alternative_hypothesis, test_method, observed_statistic, effect_size, finite p_value in [0,1], and result_table columns p_value/test_method')
if _check_keys('negative_control_or_permutation'):
    test_method_text = str(analysis_summary.get('test_method', '')).lower()
    summary_keys_text = ' '.join(str(key).lower() for key in analysis_summary.keys())
    result_columns_text = ''
    if result_table is not None and hasattr(result_table, 'columns'):
        result_columns_text = ' '.join(str(col).lower() for col in result_table.columns)
    control_text = ' '.join([test_method_text, summary_keys_text, result_columns_text])
    has_control_or_permutation = any(
        token in control_text
        for token in ['permutation', 'randomization', 'shuffle', 'negative_control', 'null_distribution', 'control']
    )
    _set_check(
        'negative_control_or_permutation',
        'pass' if has_control_or_permutation else 'not_implemented',
    )
for check in list(checks):
    if checks[check] == 'not_run' and ('negative_control' in check or check.endswith('_control')):
        checks[check] = 'not_implemented'

required_for_pass = ['required_fields_exist', 'minimum_cell_count', 'finite_numeric_output', 'statistical_hypothesis_test']
status = 'pass'
for check in required_for_pass:
    if _check_status(check) == 'fail':
        status = 'fail'
        notes.append(f'{check} failed')
n_rows_for_status = analysis_summary.get('n_rows')
if n_rows_for_status is None:
    n_rows_for_status = len(result_table) if result_table is not None else 0
if n_rows_for_status == 0:
    status = 'fail'
    notes.append('analysis produced no result rows')

verification = {
    'idea_id': IDEA.idea_id,
    'status': status,
    'checks': checks,
    'parameter_value': analysis_summary.get('parameter_value'),
    'p_value': analysis_summary.get('p_value'),
    'test_method': analysis_summary.get('test_method'),
    'effect_size': analysis_summary.get('effect_size'),
    'result_path': analysis_summary.get('result_path'),
    'notes': notes + analysis_summary.get('notes', []),
}
print(json.dumps(verification, indent=2))

Final interpretation¶

Hypothesis. Cells with higher Aldoc RNA expression exhibit increased LaminB1-associated chromatin signal, linking expression state to lamina-proximal chromatin organization.

Exploration. The notebook operationalized the idea as Spearman rho between per-cell Aldoc expression and per-cell mean tracks.LaminB1 over all spots. using modalities if_tracks, cell_metadata, rna_expression in cell type(s) Granule, Bergmann, Purkinje. Required data fields checked: spots.cell_id, tracks.LaminB1, cells.cell_type, linked_adata.X, linked_adata.var.Aldoc.

Statistical evidence. U-Chrom runner status: Notebook verified. Test: Spearman correlation with fixed-seed one-sided permutation test (1000 Aldoc-label shuffles). Observed statistic: 0.5356; effect size: 0.5356; parameter value: 0.5356; p-value: 0.07093.

Conclusion. Borderline (Expected direction). The observed effect is compatible with the expected direction, but does not pass the nominal p <= 0.05 threshold.

What verification means. Notebook verified means the run passed schema/data checks, produced finite numeric output, and included an explicit p-value/effect-size hypothesis test. It does not mean the biological hypothesis is automatically correct.

Checks passed. deterministic_rerun, finite_numeric_output, required_fields_exist, runtime_under_budget, statistical_hypothesis_test.

Main caveat. Permutation p-value tests positive Spearman association by shuffling Aldoc labels across cells.

Final interpretation¶

The required fields were present and the lightweight inspection confirmed aligned cell IDs between cdata.cells and linked_adata.obs_names, 9 total cells with 3 cells per listed cell type, and complete finite LaminB1 coverage for all cell-assigned spots. The main analysis computed per-cell mean tracks.LaminB1 over all spots and correlated it with linked Aldoc RNA expression.

Hypothesis test. The primary across-cell test was a fixed-seed one-sided permutation Spearman correlation using 1,000 Aldoc-label shuffles. The observed Spearman rho was 0.536 with one-sided permutation p = 0.0709 (n = 9 cells). This is a positive exploratory association in the expected direction, but not strong evidence at a conventional 0.05 threshold.

The saved statistical figure is non-blank and readable: it shows the cell-level Aldoc/LaminB1 scatter by cell type, plus the Aldoc-label shuffle null distribution with the observed rho marked. Labels, p-value, effect size, sample size, and method are visible; no misleading decoration or schematic image was added.
